dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Let's talk about work. How will jobs change by 2050?
dialogue.reading: lɛts ˈtɔːk əˈbaʊt ˈwɜːrk. ˈhaʊ wɪl ˈdʒɑːbz ˈtʃeɪndʒ baɪ ˈtwɛnti ˈfɪfti?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Factories will be almost fully automatic, so there will be fewer factory jobs.
dialogue.reading: ˈfæktəriz wɪl bi ˈɔːlmoʊst ˈfʊli ˌɔːtəˈmætɪk, soʊ ðɛr wɪl bi ˈfjuːər ˈfæktəri ˌdʒɑːbz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Will there be more unemployment, then?
dialogue.reading: wɪl ðɛr bi ˈmɔːr ˌʌnɪmˈplɔɪmənt, ˈðɛn?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Maybe for a while. But there will be new jobs, too.
dialogue.reading: ˈmeɪbi fər ə ˈwaɪl. bʌt ðɛr wɪl bi ˈnuː ˈdʒɑːbz, ˈtuː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thailand is an aging society, so there will be more demand for nurses.
dialogue.reading: ˈtaɪlænd ɪz ən ˈeɪdʒɪŋ səˈsaɪəti, soʊ ðɛr wɪl bi ˈmɔːr dɪˈmænd fər ˈnɜːrsɪz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That's true. In Canada, there's already a shortage of nurses.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈtruː. ɪn ˈkænədə, ðɛrz ɔːlˈrɛdi ə ˈʃɔːrtɪdʒ əv ˈnɜːrsɪz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: And there will be less work for drivers because of self-driving cars.
dialogue.reading: ənd ðɛr wɪl bi ˈlɛs ˈwɜːrk fər ˈdraɪvərz bɪˈkɔːz əv ˌsɛlf ˈdraɪvɪŋ ˈkɑːrz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: What about cities? Will there be more people in Bangkok?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt əˈbaʊt ˈsɪtiz? wɪl ðɛr bi ˈmɔːr ˈpiːpəl ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I think there will be more people, but fewer cars and less pollution.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈθɪŋk ðɛr wɪl bi ˈmɔːr ˈpiːpəl, bʌt ˈfjuːər ˈkɑːrz ənd ˈlɛs pəˈluːʃən.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: And less water? Some experts predict a water shortage.
dialogue.reading: ənd ˈlɛs ˈwɔːtər? sʌm ˈɛkspɜːrts prɪˈdɪkt ə ˈwɔːtər ˌʃɔːrtɪdʒ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's my biggest worry. There will be more people and less water.
dialogue.reading: ðæts maɪ ˈbɪɡɪst ˈwɜːri. ðɛr wɪl bi ˈmɔːr ˈpiːpəl ənd ˈlɛs ˈwɔːtər.
